name: DeepSeek
notes: DeepSeek ships models, not an agent CLI: as of this writing the terminal agents around it (Deep Code, DeepSeek-TUI) are community projects listed as integrations, not a first-party harness. Point whichever harness you use at the endpoint; mps records deepseek as the provider. If DeepSeek ships its own CLI, this becomes a harness entry — a JSON file, not a code change.
